races.name: Insect
races.description: A cryptid from another world. They excel in physical combat, and specialise in different things. Which one will you be? (Selecting this will RE-ROLL your race among the races in the Mysticism General config file!)

races.name: Ant
races.description: Ants are fearless critters that have absurdly tanky exoskeletons, known for being bulky and hard to take down. Prepare for a long, drawn out battle if you encounter one!

races.name: Beetle
races.description: Beetles are heavy-hitting insects, focusing everything into their power. Though they are one of the stronger races, their defences are lacklustre, to put it nicely.

races.name: Centipede
races.description: Centipedes are fast, speed-oriented insects that can escape virtually any fight. Their many legs makes up for their lack of power.

races.name: Mantis
races.description: Mantises are fast-hitting insects that whittle down their opponents with quick strikes and their powerful melee skills. Some variants have even been known to melt through armor.

races.name: Scorpion
races.description: Scorpions deliver strikes with their powerful stinger, which can inflict a potent venom on their targets. In rare cases, some even gain the ability to manipulate Gravity itself.

races.name: Wasp
races.description: Wasps are frail insects that have the innate ability to fly. Though they aren't quick, they have great versatility, and it all exists to protect the Queen.

races.name: Fire Ant
races.description: An evolved ant, leaning into its offenses. They are able to ignite their physical attacks, akin to the Fire Aspect enchantment.

races.name: Fire Ant Insectar
races.description: A Fire Ant that has gained a humanoid body. It delivers painful, stinging bites and fights ferociously.

races.name: Fire Ant Savant
races.description: A Fire Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It carries out the will of the army, being a shining beacon for other Fire Ants.

races.name: Flame Soul Insect
races.description: A Fire Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Flames perfectly, singing its foes to a fiery demise.

races.name: Divine Fire Ant
races.description: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Fire Ant that has gained Divinity.

races.name: Hardshell Ant
races.description: An evolved ant, leaning into its defenses. They naturally have good bulk, making them extremely tough to take out of a fight.

races.name: Hardshell Ant Insectar
races.description: A Hardshell Ant that has gained a humanoid body. Its shell has only become tougher, and it will continue to become stronger.

races.name: Hardshell Ant Savant
races.description: A Hardshell Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It carries out the will of the army, being a shining beacon for other Hardshell Ants.

races.name: Earth Soul Insect
races.description: A Hardshell Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Earth perfectly, defending the weak and fighting off those who wrong it.

races.name: Divine Hardshell Ant
races.description: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Hardshell Ant that has gained Divinity.

races.name: Stag Beetle
races.description: An evolved beetle, leaning into its offenses. Their tough horn allows them to jab opponents to deal great damage.

races.name: Stag Beetle Insectar
races.description: A Stag Beetle that has gained a humanoid body. It can now funnel its strength into its fists, allowing it to dominate the battlefield.

races.name: Stag Beetle Savant
races.description: A Stag Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. Its exoskeleton hardens evermore, capable of utilising Mithril Strength to further enhance its capabilities.

races.name: Fantasy Soul Insect
races.description: A Stag Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Fantasy perfectly, distorting magic and removing threats with pure might alone.

races.name: Divine Stag Beetle
races.description: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Stag Beetle that has gained Divinity.

races.name: Drone Beetle
races.description: An evolved beetle, leaning into its speed. Trading damage for speed, it is now capable of flight. However, it is still too young.

races.name: Drone Beetle Insectar
races.description: A Drone Beetle that has gained a humanoid body. Its wings are much stronger and capable of traveling much quicker.

races.name: Drone Beetle Savant
races.description: A Drone Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It flies at tremendous speeds, almost capable of breaking the sound barrier with how fast it flies.

races.name: Lightning Soul Insect
races.description: A Drone Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Lightning perfectly, rupturing the battlefield and being nigh untouchable.

races.name: Divine Drone Beetle
races.description: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Drone Beetle that has gained Divinity.

races.description: An evolved centipede, leaning into its swimming ability. It loves to hunt in the vast oceans, making use of its ability to paralyze targets.

races.description: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Army Wasp that has gained Divinity.

races.name: Forgotten
races.description: The Forgotten Race struggle to remember. A ghost, an apparition of something that used to be. The remains of a soul from someone long departed, that couldn’t be reused in reincarnation. Left behind to linger the world eternally.

races.name: Remnant
races.description: These lost souls piece their past back together slowly. They have regained some semblance of self-being, but it's still not enough.

races.name: Empty
races.description: A Remnant that chose the hard way out. Instead of accepting their forgotten past, they chose to fight it, to no avail. A greater, emptier husk awaits.

races.name: Revenant
races.description: A husk of what could have been. Revenants carve their way out of the hell they have created for themselves, one soul at a time.

races.name: Divine Inferius
races.description: The culmination of one who has lost their past. They find meaning in death, defeating all, even one who has truly forgotten the world, just to attain Divinity.

races.name: Whole
races.description: Acceptance. The first step to becoming complete. When the remnants of your past collide together, only when you accept your struggles can you become Whole.

races.name: Ascended
races.description: It will be fine if you never remember your past. That is what they tell themselves. Being able to accept this truth and embrace it. That is why they Ascend past all odds to become Spiritual Lifeforms despite their challenges.

races.name: Divine Excelsius
races.description: The culmination of one who has lost their past. They find meaning in their new life, pushing past all their worries and transgressions to attain Divinity.

races.name: Lesser Elemental
races.description: A curious Elemental with a mind not yet formed. What shape will it take?

races.name: Medium Elemental
races.description: An Elemental that has evolved, taking the form of a mythological creature. Its arsenal of Spiritual Magic is now stronger as well.

races.name: Greater Elemental
races.description: An Elemental that evolved to take on a more human-like shape. Beware its powerful Greater Spiritual Magic!

races.name: Elemental Lord
races.description: A graceful and elegant evolved Elemental that wields powerful Lord-level Spiritual Magic, capable of going toe-to-toe with Ultimate Skills.

races.name: Majin Elemental Lord
races.description: A very powerful majinised Elemental that wields powerful Lord-level Spiritual Magic, capable of going toe-to-toe with Ultimate Skills.

races.name: Divine Majin Elemental
races.description: An aspect of perfection that embodies its element to perfection. This being possesses God-level Spiritual Magic rivaling King-Tier Ultimate Skills that can wipe out continents should they be cast.

races.name: Divine Elemental
races.description: An aspect of perfection that embodies its element to perfection. This being possesses God-level Spiritual Magic rivaling King-Tier Ultimate Skills that can wipe out continents should they be cast.

races.name: Lesser Angel
races.description: A spiritual life-form similar to Daemons known to wreck havoc on the world every 500 years.

races.name: Greater Angel
races.description: The evolution of a Lesser Angel with a more developed ego.

races.name: Arch Angel
races.description: Only few Angels make it to this point because of their lack of ego.

races.name: Cherub
races.description: The second most powerful type of pure Angel known.

races.name: Seraph
races.description: Only the most powerful pure Angels with the most developed ego can attain Divinity.

races.name: Fallen Lesser Angel
races.description: A lesser angel that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.

races.name: Fallen Greater Angel
races.description: A greater angel that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.

races.name: Fallen Arch Angel
races.description: An arch angel that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.

races.name: Fallen SoulAberration
races.description: A cherub that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.

races.name: Fallen ReaperAberration
races.description: A seraph that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.

races.name: Lesser Fallen
races.description: A lesser angel that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.

races.name: Greater Fallen
races.description: A greater angel that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.

races.name: Arch Fallen
races.description: An arch angel that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.

races.name: Fallen Lord
races.description: A cherub that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.

races.name: Fallen
races.description: A seraph that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.

races.name: Phantom
races.description: A demi-spiritual creature born in the Underworld by the magicules of the World Destroying Dragon.

races.name: Field Officer
races.description: The evolution of a Phantom with an ego, now having the ability to split bodies.

races.name: General
races.description: A commanding officer of the Phantom army.

races.name: Staff Officer
races.description: A high graded officer of the Phantom army.

races.name: Mystic Angel
races.description: A ReaperAberration that got corrupted by the magicules of the World Destroying Dragon, but still kept their status as holy beings.

races.name: Tengu
races.description: The result of an angel possessing an Okami.

races.name: Tengu Saint
races.description: The result of a Tengu becoming once more a spiritual being.

races.name: Divine Tengu
races.description: The result of a Tengu achieving Divinity.

races.name: Greater Doll
races.description: The result of a Greater Daemon possessing a magisteel body.

races.name: Arch Doll
races.description: The result of an Arch Daemon possessing a magisteel body.

races.name: Chaos Doll
races.description: The result of an Arch Doll reversing its alignment to become Chaos aligned.

races.name: Chaos Metalloid
races.description: The result of a Chaos Doll  achieving Divinity and awakening.

races.name: Daemon Doll
races.description: The result of an Arch Doll acquiring a name.

races.name: Devil Doll
races.description: The result of a Daemon Doll achieving Divinity and awakening.

races.name: Dragonoid
races.description: A child of the stars and hopes of the world. Can you obtain true power? You can only ever evolve once, but your stats grow with your EP.

races.name: True Dragonoid
races.description: A child of the stars and hopes of the world. A being that has achieved divinity, challenging the existence that brought you into this world.

races.name: Sculk Worm
races.description: An ancient family of sculk inhabitants, where evolution has given them permanent darkness. Starts off weak, but grows to become a monstrosity.

races.name: Soul Shrieker
races.description: A sculk worm has tapped into their inner potential as a sculk inhabitant, and learned how to utilize its sound-based organs to fire projectiles.

races.name: Warden
races.description: Wardens are terrible creatures that inhabit the Deep Dark, always waiting and always ready to strike.

races.name: Soul Aberration
races.description: Very rarely, a Warden can evolve to an even bigger monstrosity. What this one will do with its power is still unknown. It is a demi-spiritual lifeform.

races.name: Reaper Aberration
races.description: One can only hope this thing does not find you. It has achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.name: Molten Perforator
races.description: A rare mutation of a sculk worm achieved through forcibly devouring Flame Essence. Now it thrives in the Nether.

races.name: Magma Worm
races.description: "And his brother loved worms..." A powerful evolved variant of the sculk worm, gaining a long, worm-like appendage.

races.name: Enflamed Aberration
races.description: These creatures have evolved to look eerily similar to their overworld counterparts. Pray that its power is not truly unleashed. It is a demi-spiritual lifeform.

races.name: Violence Deity
races.description: What was once a sculk worm has truly disappeared. This is a monstrosity and there is no going back. It has achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.name: Charged Perforator
races.description: A rare mutation of a sculk worm. It consumed essence of Lightning itself and gained specific abilities. But this one... Seems weird.

races.name: Overloading Worm
races.description: "The Reminder." When two brothers played, this one watched.

races.name: Lightning Aberration
races.description: Pray that its power is not truly unleashed. Know the fear and drive behind an aberration of pure electricity. It is a demi-spiritual lifeform.

races.name: Dissonance Deity
races.description: What was once a sculk worm has truly disappeared. "The beast stretched from one horizon to the next and belched storms that reminded all of the hero’s promise: that this land – and all those who live here - would never suffer again..." It has achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.name: Direwolf
races.description: Direwolves are a species of monster that love to cause havoc. The more intelligent and friendly ones are capable of giving others a ride on their back. They have great potential for growth.

races.name: Black Fang
races.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to magic. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.

races.name: Mystical Black Fang
races.description: An evolved Black Fang that has a deep connection to magic. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.

races.name: Magic Spirit Wolf
races.description: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Black Fangs bow to this creature.

races.name: Blue Fang
races.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to water. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.

races.description: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Scorch Wolves bow to this creature.

races.name: Star Wolf
races.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to storms. Their tails can create strong winds when wagging and they are able to reduce their size.

races.name: Divine Wolf
races.description: Direwolf that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.name: Attuned Wyrm
races.description: A race of wyrm that as yet to find a element to evolve into, it searches for ways to evolve while it wanders the world.

races.name: Lesser Glacier Wyrm
races.description: A Race of Wyrm that live in the depth of the Icy Tundras, thriving on the cold and all those live in it.

races.name: Greater Glacier Wyrm
races.description: A higher evolution of the wyrm that live in the Icy Tundras, even more powerful and deadly then their previous evolutions, using its icy breath to freeze all those who come across it.A higher evolution of the wyrm that live in the Icy Tundras, even more powerful and deadly then their previous evolutions, using its icy breath to freeze all those who come across it.

races.name: Frostcoil Sea Serpent
races.description: A sea dragon race that lives in the coldest depths of the Ocean's tundra's, using its enhanced ears to find its prey, and its speed to catch them.

races.name: Frostwrought Leviathan
races.description: A deadly dragon that lives near the bottom of the ocean's, a tame but deadly race able to manipulate sound to find and catch threads.

races.name: Rimefang Drake
races.description: A wingless dragon monster that lives in the icy tundras, thanks to its improved eyesight, its able to see its prey from far distances.

races.name: Rimeblight Hydra
races.description: A deadly, three headed dragon monster that thrives in the cold mountains of the tundra, using its 3 heads to Poison, Paralyze and freeze its foes.

races.name: Lesser Pyre Wyrm
races.description: A race of wyrm that live hottest deserts, thriving on the heat and all those that live in it.

races.name: Greater Pyre Wyrm
races.description: A higher evolution of the wyrm that lives in the deserts, using its flaming breath to scorch its preys as it hunts those unprepared for the heat.

races.name: Scorchtail Salamander
races.description: A monster race that soars through the skies as it hunts for its next meal, diving down as it breaths its flaming breath on unsuspecting prey below.

races.name: Scorchtalon Wyvern
races.description: A dragon monster race that scorches all those who come across it. Even its own kind is not safe from it.

races.name: Sunfire Lindwurm
races.description: A wingless spiritual dragon race that crawls across the ground, it helps those that it can, while also hunting for its own prey, it shows mercy, making sure to end the lives of prey quick and swiftly using rays of light.

races.name: Sundeity Loong
races.description: Having learned to fly without wings, it soars through the air, using magic to rain down light on its foes and save others.

items.name: Darkness Core
tooltips: Used to convert a Fallen Angel into a Fallen. Cannot be used by any other race.

enchantments.name: Boreal Frost
enchantments.description: Damaging your foes with this weapon causes cold, biting Permafrost to pierce their very being.

enchantments.name: Holy Flames
enchantments.description: Damaging your foes with this weapon causes them to burst into bright, powerful Brimstone flames.
